claim_text: The Search Module's Anatomy From `scour_0108` and `scour_0002`, I see `rummage.py` — a search utility with: - `Document`, `Section`, `Match` dataclasses - Regex-based heading parsing - Section classification (preamble, strand, loss, question, closing) - `KNOWN_SOURCES` hardcoded paths The module is clean but brittle — assumes consistent markdown structure.
